component.name: Universal Linux Terminal
component.summary: A host Linux terminal with beginner-friendly command guidance

description.p: Universal Linux Terminal combines a real, interactive Linux host terminal with a searchable command helper and context-aware command composition.
Discover installed commands, read available command descriptions and options, and prepare commands for manual review before running them.

ul.li: Interactive terminal powered by GTK 3 and VTE
Automatic Linux distribution and native package-manager detection
Categories for system utilities, Flatpak, networking, disks, files, and more
Searchable commands with option suggestions and command previews

description.p: This is intentionally a host-access terminal rather than a confined terminal emulator. Its Flatpak permissions allow launching host commands and accessing host files. Review commands before executing them, and only install packages from sources you trust.
Fix multi-line clipboard paste using terminal-supported bracketed paste; provide a separate interrupt action and an application Stop action.
First stable release, tested on Bazzite with KDE Plasma, Xubuntu with Xfce, and openSUSE Leap with GNOME.
